translated: The Sainte-Baume Regional Nature Park is a regional nature park created by decree on December 20, 2017, with a perimeter of approximately 84,367 ha distributed between the two departments of Bouches-du-Rhône and Var, around the massif of the same name. It is the 52nd French Regional Natural Park.
